question_answered: Can every input be traced to an official source with a timestamp, and is the reuse allowed?
pass_rule: Every input row has an allow-listed HTTPS source link, the observation time is recorded, and reuse terms have been reviewed in writing
current_status: Blocked — permission for systematic NFL data reuse is not recorded (Flag F16)

question_answered: Was the hypothesis, the feature set, the cutoff and the metric written down before any result was seen?
pass_rule: A dated committed preregistration exists and no result predates it
current_status: Open — no strategy has a preregistration yet

question_answered: Is every feature value the value that was actually knowable at the forecast cutoff?
pass_rule: For every feature the observation time is at or before the cutoff and a replay reproduces the same value
current_status: Open — the injury page publishes no update time (Flag F13)

question_answered: Does the signal beat a declared baseline out of sample?
pass_rule: The pre-declared metric improves over the declared baseline on held-out data, with a bootstrap interval that excludes no improvement

question_answered: Do predicted probabilities match observed frequencies?
pass_rule: Reliability is monotone and the calibration slope interval includes 1 in the pre-declared band

question_answered: Is the apparent edge stable across time periods, teams and conditions?
pass_rule: The metric holds in a temporally later block that was never used for selection

question_answered: Was the size of the search accounted for?
pass_rule: The reported interval and the gate decision use a procedure that accounts for the number of strategies and comparisons tried
current_status: Open — search log not yet kept

question_answered: Is the net result computed after the actual cost and the actual settlement rules?
pass_rule: Prices, pushes, voids and settlement are modelled explicitly and a push is neither a win nor a loss
current_status: Blocked — no authorized price series (Flag F07)

question_answered: Could the result have been found by looking at the answer?
pass_rule: A written audit confirms no target leakage and the feature list was frozen before evaluation

question_answered: Can an independent reviewer rebuild the result from the repository?
pass_rule: The build is deterministic, inputs and code are committed, and an independent rerun matches
current_status: Partially met — the build is deterministic and validated, but no strategy result exists

question_answered: Does the availability signal improve a pregame forecast of the result?
pass_rule: EG0 to EG9 pass for a single-bet signal and the improvement survives a bootstrap comparison with the availability-only baseline

question_answered: Does confirmed role and availability improve a player-opportunity forecast?
pass_rule: EG0 to EG9 pass and predicted opportunity distributions are calibrated out of sample

question_answered: Is the measured joint rate different from the product of the marginals?
pass_rule: EG0 to EG9 pass, a paired sample exists, and the joint-rate difference has an interval that excludes zero after multiplicity control

question_answered: Does a cross-game ticket beat independence after costs?
pass_rule: EG0 to EG9 pass, the ticket-level joint rate is calibrated, and the result survives per-leg cost and void rules

question_answered: May this strategy appear on the leaderboard at all?
pass_rule: EG0 to EG9 pass and at least one family gate EG10 to EG13 passes

question_answered: Is the entry's skill distinguishable from luck?
pass_rule: The interval around the entry's score excludes the luck-only benchmark and the procedure is adjusted for the number of entries

question_answered: Is a reward lawful, funded and clearly scoped in the user's jurisdiction?
pass_rule: A qualified legal review covers the jurisdiction and the contest design, and a written funding and terms document exists
current_status: Blocked — contest and reward legality unresolved (Flag F09)

question_answered: Is the public entry lagged so it cannot be used as a live tip?
pass_rule: Published entries are lagged and marked as research and no live price is published
